title: I Tracked the Metals-Studio Fob Through Three Audits After They Cloned Mine

parts.text: I swiped the metals door at 10:03 a.m. and intern Beau was already at my numbered bench. The board said: ONE FOB. AUDITS WEEKLY. I was thirty, metals lead, holding a fob that listed my name. Beau shrugged. "Interns share the shop." I photographed the board, the swipe log, and his clone still in the reader. Then I asked for the audit. At 10:11 the desk pinged two fobs on one name.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The desk just pinged two fobs on my numbered name.

social.video_title: They cloned my metals-studio fob — Part 1/3
social.description: One-fob board, an intern at my bench, two swipes on my name. Would you have asked for the audit?

parts.text: Wednesday the clone opened the pickle room. I printed Tuesday's dual swipe and taped it to the board. Beau called it training. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. The board now has the still. At 10:16 the desk asked why my name opened two doors at once. Beau said optics. Optics is a word interns use when a fob exists.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The clone opened the pickle room; the board now has the still.

social.video_title: My name opened two doors at once — Part 2/3
social.description: Pickle room, a dual swipe, a still on the board. Was training ever a clone?

parts.text: Friday the board added a second line: INTERNS DO NOT SHARE A FOB. Beau ran his own fob and told the next intern atmosphere was always about optics. I keep our audits on a labeled card. The clone is deactivated. Beau brown-bags his training. The door finally looks like a name, not a copy. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: Interns do not share a fob — Part 3/3
social.description: Second line on the board, clone deactivated, weekly audits. Was training ever two doors?
